title: Create Account / Signup Page
summary: F276 signup feature discovered fully implemented during Phase 1 scout. All 7 acceptance criteria verified. No code changes required. This represents a unique case where careful planning (F061: Better-auth integration) enabled rapid pre-implementation.

code_quality.architectural_decisions: Form state managed via TanStack React Form with Zod validators; async auth calls wrapped in error handling; loading states via isPending checks; navigation via TanStack Router

dependencies.implication: Foundation features can enable pre-implementation of dependent features through early scaffolding

lessons_learned.planning_quality: Excellent scaffolding via better-t-stack with better-auth enabled pre-implementation of signup. Early architectural decisions (form state library, validation framework, error handling) cascaded into complete feature.
lessons_learned.discovery_process: Phase 1 scout using careful code examination and acceptance criteria mapping efficiently validated feature completeness without false negatives.
lessons_learned.dependency_management: Critical dependencies (F061: auth setup) should be prioritized even if marked backlog, as they unlock pre-implementation of dependent features
lessons_learned.efficiency: Pre-implemented features validate system design quality and avoid redundant implementation work, but require careful verification to confirm all AC are truly met

risk_assessment.recommendation: Mark as verified. Consider documenting signup pattern in architecture docs for future auth features.
